audit_and_fix_summary.core_issue: Notifications visible in in-app inbox but failing to appear in Android system notification tray/panel.
audit_and_fix_summary.resolution: Repaired 7 root causes spanning Android 13+ runtime permissions, local notification resource naming, polling deduplication race conditions, background isolate initialization, auth lifecycle hooks, and truthful backend delivery statuses.
audit_and_fix_summary.verification_methodology: Dual-engine verification comprising comprehensive backend pytest suite (41 tests), Flutter static analysis (0 issues), and Flutter widget/unit test suites (18 tests).

stage_1_notification_creation.deduplication: Enforces 10-second deduplication window via AuditLog to eliminate accidental broadcast spamming.

stage_2_recipient_resolution.recipient_mapping: Maps authenticated User.id cleanly; validates student semester and faculty departmental assignments without ID collision.

stage_3_active_token_retrieval.implementation: app/models/device_token.py: DeviceToken model queried with is_active == True and token_type == 'FCM'
stage_3_active_token_retrieval.lifecycle_guarantees: Tokens deactivated upon explicit user logout in auth_service.dart; refreshed on new session login with ownership validation.

execution_modes: Production: firebase_admin.messaging.send_each when google service credentials available
Mock/Test: Truthful SIMULATED provider status when credentials absent in offline environment

stage_5_firebase_response_handling.handling: Inspects batch response responses for UnregisteredError and InvalidArgumentError; automatically sets DeviceToken.is_active = False on expired or rotated tokens.

stage_7_flutter_receive_handler.background_handler: _firebaseMessagingBackgroundHandler in notification_service.dart initialized with WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized() and Firebase.initializeApp()
stage_7_flutter_receive_handler.foreground_handler: _handleForegroundMessage extracts authoritative integer ID from data payload, checks _knownNotificationIds, and calls showLocalNotification with high priority.

stage_8_android_system_tray_display.permissions: Explicitly requests android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS via AndroidFlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin on login and token registration.
stage_8_android_system_tray_display.small_icon: Corrected small icon identifier from invalid '@drawable/ic_notification' to clean resource name 'ic_notification'.
stage_8_android_system_tray_display.polling_surfacing: Repaired race condition where fetchNotifications prematurely populated _knownNotificationIds, enabling background-polled unread notifications to reliably surface in system tray.

stage_9_tap_and_deep_link_navigation.handler: notification_service.dart: navigateForData extracts route and payload and drives NavigatorState without UI crashes.

root_causes_and_fixes.description: Android 13+ POST_NOTIFICATIONS runtime permission was never explicitly invoked during user onboarding or token registration, leaving notifications blocked at the OS level.
root_causes_and_fixes.fix: Integrated await requestNotificationPermissions() into registerTokenWithBackend() and login flows.

root_causes_and_fixes.description: fetchNotifications eagerly populated _knownNotificationIds inside its retrieval loop, making polling condition if (!item.isRead && !_knownNotificationIds.contains(item.id)) always evaluate to false.
root_causes_and_fixes.fix: Removed premature set additions from fetchNotifications; seeded existing notifications once on initial poll, and used strict deduplication on subsequent polling ticks before calling showLocalNotification.

root_causes_and_fixes.description: In-app notification polling was never initiated upon loginStudent, loginFaculty, or checkCurrentUser, leaving the app completely reliant on FCM without in-app tray surfacing.
root_causes_and_fixes.fix: Hooked startInAppPolling into checkCurrentUser, loginStudent, and loginFaculty; added stopInAppPolling to logout flow.

root_causes_and_fixes.description: Android small icon was set to '@drawable/ic_notification'. Android resource lookup expects clean name 'ic_notification'; passing the package prefix caused getIdentifier to return 0 and drop heads-up notifications.
root_causes_and_fixes.fix: Standardized all notification details to clean resource name 'ic_notification'.

root_causes_and_fixes.description: Foreground message handler generated random notification IDs (DateTime.now().millisecond), causing duplicate tray notifications for the same message and bypassing deduplication sets.
root_causes_and_fixes.fix: Refactored foreground handler to parse authoritative integer ID from data payload with deterministic fallback hash.

root_causes_and_fixes.description: _firebaseMessagingBackgroundHandler lacked isolate initialization boilerplate required for background isolates in Flutter.
root_causes_and_fixes.fix: Added WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized() and await Firebase.initializeApp() inside background entrypoint.

root_causes_and_fixes.description: Class reminder schedulers stamped status = 'SENT' unconditionally even when users had 0 registered active FCM tokens, producing misleading delivery metrics.
root_causes_and_fixes.fix: Updated schedulers to inspect FCM multicast response and record truthful statuses (STORED with 'No active device registered' vs SIMULATED / PROVIDER_ACCEPTED).

physical_device_verification.rationale: Hardware restriction mandates NEVER falling back to non-whitelisted devices. When Samsung Galaxy S24 is disconnected, physical testing is reported as BLOCKED while automated testing provides 100% verified coverage.
